description: Module-level test of canonical-chain branches in presymptomatic DMD infant muscle vs age-matched controls
code:
import pandas as pd, numpy as np, os, re, json
from scipy import stats
from statsmodels.stats.multitest import multipletests
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

MX="GSE6011_series_matrix.txt.gz"; AN="GPL96.annot.gz"
# ---- sample table ----
lines=pd.read_csv(MX, compression="gzip", sep="\x01", header=None, nrows=80, dtype=str, quoting=3, engine="python")[0].tolist()
def field(n):
    for l in lines:
        if l.startswith(n+"\t"): return [x.strip('"') for x in l.split("\t")[1:]]
    return []
chars=[l for l in lines if l.startswith("!Sample_characteristics_ch1")]
S=pd.DataFrame(dict(acc=field("!Sample_geo_accession"), src=field("!Sample_source_name_ch1"),
                    sex=[x.strip('"').replace("sex: ","") for x in chars[0].split("\t")[1:]],
                    age=[float(re.search(r"([\d.]+)",x).group(1)) for x in chars[1].split("\t")[1:]]))
S["group"]=np.where(S.src.str.contains("normal|control",case=False),"CTRL","DMD")

# ---- annotation: find the table header row ----
ahdr=pd.read_csv(AN, compression="gzip", sep="\x01", header=None, nrows=40, dtype=str, quoting=3, engine="python")[0].tolist()
skip=[i for i,l in enumerate(ahdr) if l.startswith("ID\t")][0]
ann=pd.read_csv(AN, sep="\t", compression="gzip", skiprows=skip, dtype=str, quoting=3, on_bad_lines="skip")
ann=ann[ann.ID.notna()]
print("annot:", ann.shape, list(ann.columns)[:5])
sym=dict(zip(ann.ID, ann["Gene symbol"]))

expr=pd.read_csv(MX, sep="\t", compression="gzip", comment="!", index_col=0, quoting=3).dropna(how="all")
expr.index=[str(i).strip('"') for i in expr.index]; expr.columns=[c.strip('"') for c in expr.columns]
expr["sym"]=[sym.get(i) for i in expr.index]
expr=expr[expr.sym.notna() & (expr.sym!="")]
S=S.set_index("acc").reindex([c for c in expr.columns if c!="sym"])
g_d=S.index[S.group=="DMD"].tolist(); g_c=S.index[S.group=="CTRL"].tolist()
print(f"DMD n={len(g_d)} median age {S.loc[g_d,'age'].median():.0f} mo (range {S.loc[g_d,'age'].min():.1f}-{S.loc[g_d,'age'].max():.0f}); "
      f"CTRL n={len(g_c)} median {S.loc[g_c,'age'].median():.0f} mo")
print("age Mann-Whitney p=%.3g" % stats.mannwhitneyu(S.loc[g_d,'age'], S.loc[g_c,'age']).pvalue)

E=expr.groupby("sym").max(); X=E[g_d+g_c].astype(float)
a=X[g_d].values; b=X[g_c].values
t,p=stats.ttest_ind(a,b,axis=1,equal_var=False)
sd=np.sqrt((a.var(1,ddof=1)+b.var(1,ddof=1))/2)
R=pd.DataFrame(dict(log2FC=a.mean(1)-b.mean(1), t=t, p=p,
                    cohens_d=(a.mean(1)-b.mean(1))/np.where(sd==0,np.nan,sd)), index=X.index)
R["fdr"]=multipletests(np.nan_to_num(R.p,nan=1), method="fdr_bh")[1]
R.to_csv("GSE6011_DMD_vs_control_gene_stats.csv")
print("\ngenes:", len(R), " FDR<0.05:", int((R.fdr<0.05).sum()))
print("\nPositive control DMD gene:\n", R.loc[["DMD"]].to_string())
print("\nTop 10 UP:\n", R.sort_values("t",ascending=False).head(10).to_string())
print("\nTop 10 DOWN:\n", R.sort_values("t").head(10).to_string())

# ---------- module analysis: branches of the canonical causal chain ----------
MOD={
 "DGC / sarcolemmal complex":["DMD","SGCA","SGCB","SGCD","SGCG","DAG1","SSPN","SNTA1","SNTB1","DTNA","NOS1","UTRN"],
 "Membrane repair":["DYSF","TRIM72","ANXA1","ANXA2","ANXA6","MYOF","CAV3","S100A10"],
 "Calcium-dependent proteases":["CAPN1","CAPN2","CAPN3","CAPNS1","CAST"],
 "Calcium handling / stress channels":["TRPC1","TRPV2","ATP2A1","ATP2A2","CASQ1","RYR1","SLC8A1","CALM1"],
 "NADPH oxidase / redox":["CYBB","NCF1","NCF2","NCF4","CYBA","RAC2","SOD1","SOD2","CAT","GPX1"],
 "Regeneration / immature myofiber":["MYH3","MYH8","MYOG","MYF5","MYF6","PAX7","NCAM1","TNNT2","IGF2","MEST","DLK1","CDKN1A"],
 "Inflammation / myeloid":["SPP1","CD68","CD14","TYROBP","C1QA","C1QB","C1QC","CCL2","TNF","IL1B","LGALS3","FCGR3A","AIF1","PTPRC"],
 "Fibrosis / ECM":["COL1A1","COL1A2","COL3A1","COL5A1","COL5A2","COL6A3","FN1","LUM","POSTN","TGFB1","CTGF","SPARC","BGN","FBN1","TIMP1"],
 "Adipogenic":["ADIPOQ","FABP4","PLIN1","CD36","LEP","CIDEC","PPARG"],
 "Mature contractile / metabolic":["MYH1","MYH2","ACTN3","CKM","MYBPC1","TNNT3","PYGM","PFKM","COX6A2","ATP5F1A"],
}
rows=[]
bg=R.cohens_d.dropna()
for m,gl in MOD.items():
    present=[g for g in gl if g in R.index]
    ds=R.loc[present,"cohens_d"].dropna()
    if len(ds)<3: continue
    U,pu=stats.mannwhitneyu(ds, bg, alternative="two-sided")
    rows.append(dict(module=m, n_genes=len(ds), median_d=float(ds.median()),
                     mean_log2FC=float(R.loc[present,"log2FC"].mean()),
                     n_fdr05=int((R.loc[present,"fdr"]<0.05).sum()), p_vs_background=pu))
M=pd.DataFrame(rows)
M["p_fdr"]=multipletests(M.p_vs_background, method="fdr_bh")[1]
M=M.sort_values("median_d", ascending=False)
print("\n=== Module-level effect sizes, presymptomatic DMD vs age-matched control quadriceps (GSE6011) ===")
print(M.to_string(index=False, float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.3g}"))
M.to_csv("GSE6011_module_scores.csv", index=False)

key=["DMD","CAPN3","CAPN1","CAPN2","TRIM72","DYSF","SPP1","COL1A1","COL3A1","TGFB1","MYH3","MYH8","CYBB","TRPC1","TRPV2","NOS1","UTRN","LGALS3","TIMP1","FABP4"]
print("\nSelected genes:\n", R.loc[[k for k in key if k in R.index], ["log2FC","cohens_d","p","fdr"]].to_string(float_format=lambda x:f"{x:.3g}"))

fig,axes=plt.subplots(1,2,figsize=(14.5,5.4))
y=np.arange(len(M))
cols=["#C44E52" if v>0 else "#4C72B0" for v in M.median_d]
axes[0].barh(y, M.median_d, color=cols)
axes[0].set_yticks(y); axes[0].set_yticklabels([f"{m}\n(n={n}, {k} at FDR<0.05)" for m,n,k in zip(M.module,M.n_genes,M.n_fdr05)], fontsize=7.5)
axes[0].invert_yaxis(); axes[0].axvline(0,color="k",lw=.8)
axes[0].set_xlabel("median Cohen's d, DMD vs control")
axes[0].set_title("Canonical-chain branches in presymptomatic DMD muscle\nGSE6011, 23 DMD infants vs 14 age-matched controls")
for i,(v,q) in enumerate(zip(M.median_d, M.p_fdr)):
    axes[0].text(v+(0.06 if v>0 else -0.06), i, f"FDR {q:.2g}", va="center", ha="left" if v>0 else "right", fontsize=7)
sig=R[(R.fdr<0.05)]
axes[1].scatter(R.log2FC, -np.log10(R.p.clip(lower=1e-300)), s=4, color="#BBBBBB", alpha=.5)
axes[1].scatter(sig.log2FC, -np.log10(sig.p.clip(lower=1e-300)), s=5, color="#C44E52", alpha=.6)
for g in ["DMD","SPP1","COL1A1","COL3A1","MYH3","MYH8","CAPN3","TIMP1","LGALS3","TRIM72"]:
    if g in R.index:
        axes[1].annotate(g, (R.loc[g,"log2FC"], -np.log10(max(R.loc[g,"p"],1e-300))), fontsize=7.5)
axes[1].axvline(0,color="k",lw=.6); axes[1].set_xlabel("log2 fold change (DMD - control)"); axes[1].set_ylabel("-log10 p")
axes[1].set_title(f"{int((R.fdr<0.05).sum())} genes at FDR<0.05 of {len(R)}")
plt.tight_layout(); plt.show()
